title: CTL AEO-500 — 500 Cited AEO Questions on Black Culture
status: Pre-publication package (v1.0 assembled 2026-11-16 from the 2026-11-04/05 build). Zenodo deposit pending the founder's token sitting; no DOI yet.
creator: CultureTechLens NFP
description: 500 answer-engine question units on Black culture — each with a primary question, a cited direct answer (31-55 words), a 5-question cluster, keywords, a Wikidata QID or an honest NONE marker, and a dated verification note (2026-11-04). Assembled from the verified KG333 (333) and FC300 (167) registries. Citation statuses are the dataset's evidence vocabulary: 321 rows rest on Wikipedia/Wikidata, 88 fictional characters carry franchise coverage only, and 11 rows are GAPs where CultureTechLens is the source of record and no external page exists.
